title: 2 Cost & weight
description: Analysis of our customers' live data. The system only suggests; a person decides.

options.content: 🟢 **Live (ESP32):** [Site now](/d/smart-compactor) · [Pickups](/d/live-pickups) · [Money & CO₂](/d/live-money) · [Devices](/d/edge-live)   |   📊 **Analysis (all customers):** [1 Problems](/d/value-cockpit) · **● 2 Cost & weight** · [3 Waste companies](/d/cockpit-operators) · [4 Invoices](/d/cockpit-actions)

### What the waste cost, per tonne — and does the invoice agree with our scale?
**Estimated** = the live estimate with the customer's prices (cost per lift − kg × price per tonne). **Billed** = what the waste companies invoiced. The middle table puts the **lifts and tonnes we measured** next to what each invoice **billed**.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((sum(p.kg_collected) / 1000)::numeric, 2) AS v FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id JOIN materials m ON m.name = c.material WHERE p.status = 'done' AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at)

panels.title: Estimated cost
panels.description: Cost per lift − kg × price per tonne, with the prices on Money & CO₂.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum((coalesce(m.lift_fee_eur, p.fee_eur, 0) - p.kg_collected * m.price_eur_per_kg))::numeric) AS v FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id JOIN materials m ON m.name = c.material WHERE p.status = 'done' AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at)

SELECT round((sum((coalesce(m.lift_fee_eur, p.fee_eur, 0) - p.kg_collected * m.price_eur_per_kg)) / NULLIF(sum(p.kg_collected) / 1000, 0))::numeric, 1) AS v FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id JOIN materials m ON m.name = c.material WHERE p.status = 'done' AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at)

SELECT round(sum(i.total_eur)::numeric) AS v FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.* FROM invoice_decisions d JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM invoice_decisions GROUP BY invoice_id) m ON m.max_id = d.id) d ON d.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.customer_name IN ($customer) AND i.operator_name IN ($operator)

SELECT round(sum(i.overcharged_eur)::numeric) AS v FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.* FROM invoice_decisions d JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM invoice_decisions GROUP BY invoice_id) m ON m.max_id = d.id) d ON d.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.customer_name IN ($customer) AND i.operator_name IN ($operator)

SELECT c.customer_name AS "Customer", p.compactor_id AS "Compactor", c.material AS "Material", c.operator_name AS "Waste company", count(*) AS "Lifts", round((sum(p.kg_collected) / 1000)::numeric, 2) AS "Tonnes", round(avg(p.load_before_pct)::numeric) AS "Avg load at lift %", round(sum((coalesce(m.lift_fee_eur, p.fee_eur, 0) - p.kg_collected * m.price_eur_per_kg))::numeric) AS "Estimated €", round((sum((coalesce(m.lift_fee_eur, p.fee_eur, 0) - p.kg_collected * m.price_eur_per_kg)) / NULLIF(sum(p.kg_collected) / 1000, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Estimated € / t" FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id JOIN materials m ON m.name = c.material WHERE p.status = 'done' AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Invoice vs our measurement, per compactor

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.invoice_id AS "Invoice", i.operator_name AS "Waste company", l.compactor_id AS "Compactor", sum(CASE WHEN l.line_type = 'LIFT_FEE' THEN coalesce(l.quantity, 1) ELSE 0 END) AS "Lifts billed", (SELECT count(*) FROM pickups p WHERE p.compactor_id = l.compactor_id AND p.status = 'done' AND p.done_at >= i.period_from AND p.done_at < i.period_to + 1) AS "Lifts measured", round(sum(CASE WHEN l.line_type IN ('PROCESSING', 'MATERIAL_CREDIT') THEN CASE WHEN l.unit = 'kg' THEN l.quantity / 1000 ELSE l.quantity END ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 3) AS "Tonnes billed", (SELECT round((sum(p.kg_collected) / 1000)::numeric, 3) FROM pickups p WHERE p.compactor_id = l.compactor_id AND p.status = 'done' AND p.done_at >= i.period_from AND p.done_at < i.period_to + 1) AS "Tonnes measured", round(sum(l.amount_eur)::numeric, 2) AS "Billed €", round(sum(l.difference_eur)::numeric, 2) AS "Difference €" FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id = l.invoice_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.* FROM invoice_decisions d JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM invoice_decisions GROUP BY invoice_id) m ON m.max_id = d.id) d ON d.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.customer_name IN ($customer) AND i.operator_name IN ($operator) AND l.compactor_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.invoice_id, i.operator_name, l.compactor_id, i.period_from, i.period_to ORDER BY i.invoice_id, l.compactor_id

SELECT p.done_at AS "Emptied", c.customer_name AS "Customer", p.compactor_id AS "Compactor", c.material AS "Material", c.operator_name AS "Waste company", p.load_before_pct AS "Load %", p.kg_collected AS "kg", round((coalesce(m.lift_fee_eur, p.fee_eur, 0) - p.kg_collected * m.price_eur_per_kg)::numeric, 2) AS "Estimated €", p.co2_kg AS "CO₂ saved kg" FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id JOIN materials m ON m.name = c.material WHERE p.status = 'done' AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at) ORDER BY p.done_at DESC LIMIT 1000
